feedback: The current candidate shows some improvement attempts by lowering kp to 0.9 and increasing kd to 0.1, with a slight increase in ki to 0.07. However, the race telemetry indicates the robot still fails to complete either track, stalling early on the oval and going off track on the s-bend. Line loss events remain present (3 on oval, 1 on s-bend), and steering oscillation is still moderately high (~0.19). The control effort is relatively high, suggesting the controller may still be too aggressive or not well balanced. The base speed is moderate at 0.13, which is reasonable but might be slightly high given the oscillations and line loss. To improve, I recommend increasing kd further to enhance damping and reduce oscillations, lowering ki to reduce integral windup and oscillations, and slightly reducing base_speed to allow more stable control. Also, consider adjusting sensor_weights to be less extreme (e.g., reduce the magnitude of the middle sensors) to smooth sensor input influence. These changes aim to reduce line loss events, steering oscillation, and control effort, improving completion likelihood and overall score. Confirm improvements by monitoring completion, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation in the next race.
requested_changes: controller.kd to 0.12 to increase damping and reduce oscillations
controller.ki to 0.04 to reduce integral windup and oscillations
controller.base_speed to 0.11 to allow more stable control
controller.sensor_weights to [-1.0, -0.5, 0.5, 1.0] to smooth sensor input influence
